capability.summary: Add an Export Loops button that bundles every non-empty phrase as a 24-bit PCM WAV inside an uncompressed ZIP, rendered offline through the channel strip + ADSR + master gain (V1, no extensions/engine-panel processing).

controls.description: Clicking the Export Loops button while at least one phrase is non-empty produces an uncompressed ZIP blob (application/zip) containing one 24-bit PCM WAV named phrase-NN.wav per non-empty phrase, each rendered via OfflineAudioContext.
controls.test: e2e: open default song (kick four-on-the-floor in phrase 1), click Export Loops, intercept URL.createObjectURL blob, parse ZIP local headers and assert at least one entry whose name matches /^phrase-\d{2}\.wav$/, fmt='RIFF', bits per sample=24.
